manual.assortedmobs.chapter.ice_pixie.fi:
Nothing hurts an ice pixie unless you are holding a torch or flint and steel when you hit it.

Anything hot nearby burns will burn them too.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.ice_pixie.in: Ice pixies live in snowy places and come out by day as well as by night. They throw ice at any player they see, and move faster on ice and snow.
manual.assortedmobs.description: The ice pixie, the treasure mob, the two 8-bit creatures, and the sea creatures.
manual.assortedmobs.title: Assorted Mobs
